caption: Assigning connectors to a group — SQL Server listed as a blockable Premium connector on the Non-business tab
Connectors moved into Business can no longer share data in a flow with anything in Non-Business or Blocked

code:
Business group:
  SQL Server, Dataverse

Non-Business group (default):
  Outlook, Teams, Approvals

Blocked group:
  Twitter, Facebook

Result: a flow may combine SQL Server + Outlook.
No flow may combine SQL Server + Twitter.
caption: One flow can never mix connectors from two different groups — that's the entire enforcement rule
